LESSON: WRITING 15.4.1 GUIDED WRITING GRADE APPROPRIATE ADJECTIVES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.4: Writing 15.4.1 Guided Writing Grade appropriate adjectives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 15.4.1 Guided Writing Grade appropriate adjectives, part of Strand 15 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: Why are important in writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 15.4.1 Guided Writing Grade appropriate adjectives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner learns independently as they match pictures with correct sentences.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is nurtured as the learner displays team spirit during group activities.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life Skills: Effective communication is enhanced as the learner expresses himself/herself creatively in writing.

Link to other areas:

Learner relates the writing skills developed in all the other learning areas.
